items.question: Trong câu "A risk is an event that has NOT happened, could happen, and if it happens would affect project objectives.", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A risk is an event that has NOT happened, could happen, and if it happens would affect project objectives.", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a goal you aim to achieve
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. "Project objectives" = các mục tiêu của dự án (phạm vi, thời hạn, chi phí, chất lượng); lưu ý tính từ "objective" lại nghĩa là khách quan.
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (noun): a goal you aim to achieve. "Project objectives" are the goals a project must meet (scope, time, cost, quality); as an adjective, "objective" means unbiased.

items.question: Trong câu "that is not a risk — it is an issue or a constraint.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "that is not a risk — it is an issue or a constraint.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a fixed limit you must work within
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. Trong quản lý dự án, "constraint" là điều kiện không thay đổi được mà kế hoạch phải xoay quanh; cụm "time constraint" = giới hạn thời gian.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a fixed limit you must work within. In project management a "constraint" is an unchangeable condition the plan must work around; e.g. "a time constraint".

items.question: Trong câu "if a senior developer leaves in March, the payment module slips three weeks", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "if a senior developer leaves in March, the payment module slips three weeks", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ, lùi tiến độ. "The module slips three weeks" = hạng mục bị trễ ba tuần; danh từ "schedule slip" = sự trễ tiến độ.
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind schedule. "The module slips three weeks" means it is delivered three weeks late; the noun is "a schedule slip".

items.question: Trong câu "How to write a risk properly — the cause, event, consequence formula:", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to write a risk properly — the cause, event, consequence formula:", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả, hệ quả. Công thức "cause – event – consequence" = nguyên nhân – sự kiện – hậu quả; cụm "as a consequence" = do đó.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result of an event. The "cause – event – consequence" formula links a reason, what may happen and its result; "as a consequence" means as a result.

items.question: Trong câu "Because only one person understands the legacy payment system, if that person leaves, data migration slips at least four weeks.", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because only one person understands the legacy payment system, if that person leaves, data migration slips at least four weeks.", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
options: di sản, tài sản thừa kế
optionsEn: money or property left by someone
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ, kế thừa từ trước. "Legacy system" = hệ thống cũ vẫn đang chạy, thường khó sửa; danh từ "legacy" còn nghĩa là di sản.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. A "legacy system" is old software still in service and often hard to change; the noun "legacy" also means an inheritance.

items.question: Trong câu "The second sentence gives you three things immediately: a clear preventive action (train a second person), an indicator to watch (signs that person wants to leave), and a number to compare against the cost of prevention.", từ "preventive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The second sentence gives you three things immediately: a clear preventive action (train a second person), an indicator to watch (signs that person wants to leave), and a number to compare against the cost of prevention.", what does "preventive" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: intended to fix a past problem
intended to last a short time
items.explanation: preventive /prɪˈven.tɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính phòng ngừa. "Preventive action" = hành động phòng ngừa, trái với "corrective action" (hành động khắc phục).
items.explanationEn: preventive /prɪˈven.tɪv/ (adjective): intended to stop something happening. "Preventive action" stops a problem before it happens, as opposed to "corrective action" after it happens.

items.question: Trong câu "The second sentence gives you three things immediately: a clear preventive action (train a second person), an indicator to watch (signs that person wants to leave), and a number to compare against the cost of prevention.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The second sentence gives you three things immediately: a clear preventive action (train a second person), an indicator to watch (signs that person wants to leave), and a number to compare against the cost of prevention.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that shows a situation
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu, chỉ báo. "An indicator to watch" = chỉ báo cần theo dõi; cụm "key performance indicator (KPI)" = chỉ số hiệu suất chính.
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (noun): a sign that shows a situation. "An indicator to watch" is a signal you track; compare "key performance indicator (KPI)".

items.question: Trong câu "The purpose is knowing consciously which risks you are carrying.", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The purpose is knowing consciously which risks you are carrying.", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hold and move an object
items.explanation: carry /ˈkær.i/ (động từ): gánh chịu, chấp nhận mang. "Carry a risk" = chấp nhận gánh một rủi ro; nghĩa gốc là mang, vác.
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈkær.i/ (verb): to bear or accept. "Carry a risk" means accepting that you bear it; the basic sense is to hold and move something.

items.question: Trong câu "Risks do not appear on their own in a meeting — you must hunt them systematically.", từ "systematically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risks do not appear on their own in a meeting — you must hunt them systematically.", what does "systematically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: systematically /ˌsɪs.təˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): một cách có hệ thống. "Hunt them systematically" = tìm kiếm theo phương pháp, không bỏ sót; tính từ "systematic".
items.explanationEn: systematically /ˌsɪs.təˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): following a fixed method. "Hunt them systematically" means searching by a method so nothing is missed; adjective "systematic".

items.question: Trong câu "Seven risk sources to sweep on any software project", từ "sweep" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Seven risk sources to sweep on any software project", what does "sweep" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sweep /swiːp/ (động từ): rà soát kỹ lưỡng. "Sweep the sources" = rà soát lần lượt từng nguồn; nghĩa gốc là quét (nhà).
items.explanationEn: sweep /swiːp/ (verb): to search thoroughly. "Sweep the sources" means checking each one thoroughly; the literal sense is cleaning with a brush.

items.question: Trong câu "Unclear requirements in the most complex area, stakeholders who do not agree with each other, a customer who has never used a comparable system and so does not yet know what they want.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unclear requirements in the most complex area, stakeholders who do not agree with each other, a customer who has never used a comparable system and so does not yet know what they want.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person affected by the project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "Stakeholders" = mọi người/bên có lợi ích hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi dự án; cụm "stakeholder alignment" = thống nhất giữa các bên.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a person affected by the project. "Stakeholders" are everyone with an interest in or affected by a project; e.g. "stakeholder alignment".

items.question: Trong câu "Unclear requirements in the most complex area, stakeholders who do not agree with each other, a customer who has never used a comparable system and so does not yet know what they want.", từ "comparable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unclear requirements in the most complex area, stakeholders who do not agree with each other, a customer who has never used a comparable system and so does not yet know what they want.", what does "comparable" (adjective) mean?
options: tương tự, có thể so sánh
items.explanation: comparable /ˈkɒm.pər.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): tương tự, có thể so sánh. "A comparable system" = một hệ thống tương tự; đừng nhầm với "compatible" (tương thích).
items.explanationEn: comparable /ˈkɒm.pər.ə.bəl/ (adjective): similar enough to compare. "A comparable system" is a similar one; do not confuse it with "compatible".

items.question: Trong câu "Technology the team has never used, integration with an undocumented system, unvalidated performance requirements, technical debt exactly where heavy change is coming.", từ "undocumented" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technology the team has never used, integration with an undocumented system, unvalidated performance requirements, technical debt exactly where heavy change is coming.", what does "undocumented" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: undocumented /ʌnˈdɒk.jə.men.tɪd/ (tính từ): không có tài liệu. "An undocumented system/API" = hệ thống không có tài liệu mô tả; cũng dùng cho người không có giấy tờ tuỳ thân.
items.explanationEn: undocumented /ʌnˈdɒk.jə.men.tɪd/ (adjective): having no written description. "An undocumented system or API" has no written description; it can also describe a person without official papers.

items.question: Trong câu "Technology the team has never used, integration with an undocumented system, unvalidated performance requirements, technical debt exactly where heavy change is coming.", từ "technical debt" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technology the team has never used, integration with an undocumented system, unvalidated performance requirements, technical debt exactly where heavy change is coming.", what does "technical debt" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: future cost of shortcuts in code
items.explanation: technical debt /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl det/ (cụm từ): nợ kỹ thuật. "Technical debt" = cái giá phải trả sau này vì chọn giải pháp tắt; cụm "pay down technical debt" = trả bớt nợ kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: technical debt /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl det/ (phrase): future cost of shortcuts in code. "Technical debt" is the later cost of quick shortcuts; you "pay down technical debt" by cleaning them up.

items.question: Trong câu "A partner who has not opened their API, a slow vendor, regulatory change, dependence on another project.", từ "vendor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A partner who has not opened their API, a slow vendor, regulatory change, dependence on another project.", what does "vendor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vendor /ˈven.dər/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. "Vendor" = bên cung cấp sản phẩm/dịch vụ; cụm "vendor lock-in" = bị trói buộc vào một nhà cung cấp.
items.explanationEn: vendor /ˈven.dər/ (noun): a company that supplies goods. A "vendor" supplies products or services; "vendor lock-in" means being stuck with one supplier.

items.question: Trong câu "A partner who has not opened their API, a slow vendor, regulatory change, dependence on another project.", từ "regulatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A partner who has not opened their API, a slow vendor, regulatory change, dependence on another project.", what does "regulatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: regulatory /ˈreɡ.jə.lə.tər.i/ (tính từ): thuộc quy định pháp lý. "Regulatory change" = thay đổi về quy định của cơ quan quản lý; danh từ "regulation".
items.explanationEn: regulatory /ˈreɡ.jə.lə.tər.i/ (adjective): related to official rules. "Regulatory change" is a change in official rules set by authorities; the noun is "regulation".

items.question: Trong câu "The sponsor may change role, company priorities may shift next quarter, the team is shared with another project.", từ "sponsor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sponsor may change role, company priorities may shift next quarter, the team is shared with another project.", what does "sponsor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sponsor /ˈspɒn.sər/ (danh từ): người bảo trợ dự án. "Project sponsor" = lãnh đạo bảo trợ, cấp ngân sách và quyết định lớn cho dự án; nghĩa khác là nhà tài trợ sự kiện.
items.explanationEn: sponsor /ˈspɒn.sər/ (noun): the executive backing a project. A "project sponsor" is the senior person who funds and backs a project; another sense is a company funding an event.

items.question: Trong câu "The sponsor may change role, company priorities may shift next quarter, the team is shared with another project.", từ "quarter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sponsor may change role, company priorities may shift next quarter, the team is shared with another project.", what does "quarter" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quarter /ˈkwɔː.tər/ (danh từ): quý (ba tháng). "Next quarter" = quý tới; hay gặp "Q3 results", "quarterly report" (báo cáo quý).
items.explanationEn: quarter /ˈkwɔː.tər/ (noun): a three-month period. "Next quarter" means the next three-month business period; compare "quarterly report".

items.question: Trong câu "The sponsor may change role, company priorities may shift next quarter, the team is shared with another project.", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sponsor may change role, company priorities may shift next quarter, the team is shared with another project.", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): thay đổi, dịch chuyển. "Priorities may shift" = thứ tự ưu tiên có thể thay đổi; danh từ "a shift in focus".
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to change or move. "Priorities may shift" means they may change; the noun appears in "a shift in focus".

items.question: Trong câu "Work never done before, so estimates have low confidence; a long critical path with no buffer.", từ "critical path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Work never done before, so estimates have low confidence; a long critical path with no buffer.", what does "critical path" (phrase) mean?
options: chuỗi việc quyết định hạn chót
optionsEn: the task chain that sets the end date
items.explanation: critical path /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl pɑːθ/ (cụm từ): chuỗi việc quyết định hạn chót. "Critical path" = chuỗi công việc dài nhất, trễ một việc là trễ cả dự án.
items.explanationEn: critical path /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl pɑːθ/ (phrase): the task chain that sets the end date. The "critical path" is the longest chain of tasks; any delay on it delays the whole project.

items.question: Trong câu "Work never done before, so estimates have low confidence; a long critical path with no buffer.", từ "buffer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Work never done before, so estimates have low confidence; a long critical path with no buffer.", what does "buffer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (danh từ): khoảng dự phòng. "No buffer" = không có thời gian dự phòng; trong lập trình "buffer" là vùng nhớ đệm.
items.explanationEn: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (noun): spare time kept for delays. "No buffer" means no spare time for delays; in programming a "buffer" is temporary storage.

items.question: Trong câu "No production-like test environment, no rollback plan, real data containing unknown edge cases.", từ "rollback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No production-like test environment, no rollback plan, real data containing unknown edge cases.", what does "rollback" (noun) mean?
options: sự cập nhật lên bản mới
sự quay lui về bản cũ
optionsEn: an upgrade to a new version
a return to a previous version
items.explanation: rollback /ˈrəʊl.bæk/ (danh từ): sự quay lui về bản cũ. "Rollback plan" = kế hoạch quay về phiên bản trước khi triển khai lỗi; động từ "roll back".
items.explanationEn: rollback /ˈrəʊl.bæk/ (noun): a return to a previous version. A "rollback plan" says how to return to the previous version if a release fails; the verb is "roll back".

items.question: Trong câu "No production-like test environment, no rollback plan, real data containing unknown edge cases.", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No production-like test environment, no rollback plan, real data containing unknown edge cases.", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: edge case /edʒ keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên, hiếm gặp. "Edge cases" = các trường hợp ở ranh giới, ít xảy ra nhưng dễ gây lỗi; cụm "handle edge cases".
items.explanationEn: edge case /edʒ keɪs/ (phrase): a rare extreme situation. "Edge cases" are rare, extreme situations that often break code; you "handle edge cases".

items.question: Trong câu "The risk that tripped you last time is very likely to return.", từ "trip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The risk that tripped you last time is very likely to return.", what does "trip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trip /trɪp/ (động từ): làm vấp, gây thất bại. "Trip someone (up)" = khiến ai vấp ngã hoặc mắc lỗi; danh từ "trip" lại nghĩa là chuyến đi.
items.explanationEn: trip /trɪp/ (verb): to make someone fail. "Trip someone (up)" means making them stumble or fail; the noun "trip" means a journey.

items.question: Trong câu "This technique surfaces far more risks than asking", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This technique surfaces far more risks than asking", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
options: làm lộ ra, đưa ra ánh sáng
optionsEn: to rise to the water top
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, đưa ra ánh sáng. "Surface risks/issues" = làm lộ ra các rủi ro/vấn đề đang ẩn; danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to bring into view. "Surface risks or issues" means bringing hidden ones into view; the noun "surface" is the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "because it lets people be pessimistic without being labelled negative.", từ "pessimistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "because it lets people be pessimistic without being labelled negative.", what does "pessimistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pessimistic /ˌpes.ɪˈmɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): bi quan. "Be pessimistic" = bi quan, nghĩ tới điều xấu; trái nghĩa "optimistic".
items.explanationEn: pessimistic /ˌpes.ɪˈmɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): expecting bad things. "Be pessimistic" means expecting the worst; the opposite is "optimistic".

items.question: Trong câu "because it lets people be pessimistic without being labelled negative.", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "because it lets people be pessimistic without being labelled negative.", what does "label" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stick a tag on goods
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (động từ): gán mác, quy chụp. "Be labelled (as) negative" = bị gán mác tiêu cực; nghĩa gốc là dán nhãn.
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (verb): to describe someone unfairly. "Be labelled (as) negative" means being given an unfair description; the literal sense is tagging items.

items.question: Trong câu "Two basic dimensions: probability and impact.", từ "dimension" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two basic dimensions: probability and impact.", what does "dimension" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dimension /daɪˈmen.ʃən/ (danh từ): khía cạnh, tiêu chí. "Two dimensions" ở đây = hai tiêu chí đánh giá; nghĩa khác là kích thước hoặc chiều không gian (3D).
items.explanationEn: dimension /daɪˈmen.ʃən/ (noun): an aspect used to measure. Here "two dimensions" are two aspects for assessment; other senses are size or a direction in space (3D).

items.question: Trong câu "Two basic dimensions: probability and impact.", từ "probability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two basic dimensions: probability and impact.", what does "probability" (noun) mean?
options: xác suất, khả năng xảy ra
items.explanation: probability /ˌprɒb.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): xác suất, khả năng xảy ra. "Probability and impact" = khả năng xảy ra và mức ảnh hưởng, hai trục của ma trận rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: probability /ˌprɒb.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): how likely something is. "Probability and impact" are likelihood and effect, the two axes of a risk matrix.

items.question: Trong câu "Multiplying them gives risk exposure.", từ "exposure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multiplying them gives risk exposure.", what does "exposure" (noun) mean?
options: mức độ phơi nhiễm rủi ro
optionsEn: the level of risk you face
items.explanation: exposure /ɪkˈspəʊ.ʒər/ (danh từ): mức độ phơi nhiễm rủi ro. "Risk exposure" = mức rủi ro thực tế đang gánh (xác suất × ảnh hưởng); cụm "reduce exposure".
items.explanationEn: exposure /ɪkˈspəʊ.ʒər/ (noun): the level of risk you face. "Risk exposure" is the amount of risk you face (probability × impact); you try to "reduce exposure".

items.question: Trong câu "A simple scale, sufficient for most projects", từ "scale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple scale, sufficient for most projects", what does "scale" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of levels for rating
items.explanation: scale /skeɪl/ (danh từ): thang đo, thang điểm. "A simple scale" = một thang đo đơn giản (thấp/trung bình/cao); nghĩa khác "at scale" = ở quy mô lớn.
items.explanationEn: scale /skeɪl/ (noun): a set of levels for rating. "A simple scale" is a set of rating levels (low, medium, high); another sense is size, as in "at scale".

items.question: Trong câu "The most noteworthy cell is low probability, high impact.", từ "noteworthy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most noteworthy cell is low probability, high impact.", what does "noteworthy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: noteworthy /ˈnəʊtˌwɜː.ði/ (tính từ): đáng chú ý. "Noteworthy" = đáng lưu ý; đồng nghĩa "notable", "worth noting".
items.explanationEn: noteworthy /ˈnəʊtˌwɜː.ði/ (adjective): worth paying attention to. "Noteworthy" means deserving attention; synonyms are "notable" and "worth noting".

items.question: Trong câu "yet that is the kind that sinks projects.", từ "sink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "yet that is the kind that sinks projects.", what does "sink" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to ruin or cause to fail
items.explanation: sink /sɪŋk/ (động từ): làm đổ bể, huỷ hoại. "Sink a project" = làm dự án thất bại (như đánh chìm tàu); nghĩa gốc là chìm.
items.explanationEn: sink /sɪŋk/ (verb): to ruin or cause to fail. "Sink a project" means making it fail, like sinking a ship; the basic sense is going under water.

items.question: Trong câu "A risk you will see three weeks out is completely different from one that detonates without warning.", từ "detonate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A risk you will see three weeks out is completely different from one that detonates without warning.", what does "detonate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: detonate /ˈdet.ən.eɪt/ (động từ): bùng nổ bất ngờ. "Detonate without warning" = phát nổ không báo trước; ẩn dụ cho rủi ro xảy ra đột ngột.
items.explanationEn: detonate /ˈdet.ən.eɪt/ (verb): to explode suddenly. "Detonate without warning" means exploding with no signal; a metaphor for a sudden risk.

items.question: Trong câu "A hard-to-detect risk deserves higher priority at the same probability and impact.", từ "deserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A hard-to-detect risk deserves higher priority at the same probability and impact.", what does "deserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to merit or be worthy of
to have a legal claim to
items.explanation: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): xứng đáng được. "Deserve higher priority" = xứng đáng được ưu tiên hơn; cụm "deserve attention".
items.explanationEn: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to merit or be worthy of. "Deserve higher priority" means it merits being ranked higher; also "deserve attention".

items.question: Trong câu "On probability: do not pretend to precision.", từ "pretend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On probability: do not pretend to precision.", what does "pretend" (verb) mean?
options: giả vờ, làm như thể có
optionsEn: to act as if something is true
items.explanation: pretend /prɪˈtend/ (động từ): giả vờ, làm như thể có. "Pretend to precision" = làm như thể mình chính xác; cách dùng phổ biến hơn là "pretend to be".
items.explanationEn: pretend /prɪˈtend/ (verb): to act as if something is true. "Pretend to precision" means acting as if you are exact; the common pattern is "pretend to be".

items.question: Trong câu "sounds scientific but is usually invented.", từ "invent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sounds scientific but is usually invented.", what does "invent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invent /ɪnˈvent/ (động từ): bịa ra. "Is usually invented" = thường là bịa ra; nghĩa khác là phát minh (invent the telephone).
items.explanationEn: invent /ɪnˈvent/ (verb): to make up. "Is usually invented" means usually made up; another sense is creating a new device.

items.question: Trong câu "The strongest strategy but usually the costliest, since you give up the benefit that came with the risk.", từ "give up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strongest strategy but usually the costliest, since you give up the benefit that came with the risk.", what does "give up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: give up /ɡɪv ʌp/ (cụm từ): từ bỏ. "Give up the benefit" = từ bỏ lợi ích; khi không có tân ngữ, "give up" nghĩa là bỏ cuộc.
items.explanationEn: give up /ɡɪv ʌp/ (phrase): to let go of. "Give up the benefit" means losing or letting go of it; without an object, "give up" means to stop trying.

items.question: Trong câu "Mitigate — reduce the probability or the impact.", từ "mitigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mitigate — reduce the probability or the impact.", what does "mitigate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mitigate /ˈmɪt.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): giảm nhẹ. "Mitigate a risk" = giảm xác suất hoặc ảnh hưởng của rủi ro; danh từ "mitigation plan".
items.explanationEn: mitigate /ˈmɪt.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to make less severe. "Mitigate a risk" means reducing its probability or impact; the noun appears in "mitigation plan".

items.question: Trong câu "run a two-week technical spike to validate the technology before committing.", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "run a two-week technical spike to validate the technology before committing.", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
options: đợt thử nghiệm kỹ thuật ngắn
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): đợt thử nghiệm kỹ thuật ngắn. Trong Agile, "spike" = một khoảng thời gian ngắn để nghiên cứu/thử công nghệ; nghĩa khác "a spike in traffic" = tăng đột biến.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a short research experiment. In Agile a "spike" is a time-boxed experiment to explore a technology; another sense is "a spike in traffic".

items.question: Trong câu "run a two-week technical spike to validate the technology before committing.", từ "validate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "run a two-week technical spike to validate the technology before committing.", what does "validate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): kiểm chứng tính khả thi. "Validate the technology" = kiểm chứng công nghệ có đáp ứng không; cũng dùng "validate input".
items.explanationEn: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to prove it works. "Validate the technology" means proving it meets the needs; also used in "validate input".

items.question: Trong câu "run a two-week technical spike to validate the technology before committing.", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "run a two-week technical spike to validate the technology before committing.", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): cam kết, chốt quyết định. "Before committing" = trước khi chốt chọn, cam kết theo; nghĩa khác "commit a crime", "git commit".
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to make a firm decision. "Before committing" means before making a firm decision; other senses are "commit a crime" and "git commit".

items.question: Trong câu "design so that component can be swapped out if it underperforms.", từ "swap out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "design so that component can be swapped out if it underperforms.", what does "swap out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: swap out /swɒp aʊt/ (cụm từ): thay thế bằng cái khác. "Swap out a component" = thay một thành phần bằng thành phần khác; cụm "swap A for B".
items.explanationEn: swap out /swɒp aʊt/ (phrase): to replace with another. "Swap out a component" means replacing it with another; compare "swap A for B".

items.question: Trong câu "Transfer — move the risk to a party better able to carry it.", từ "transfer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transfer — move the risk to a party better able to carry it.", what does "transfer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to a new job
items.explanation: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (động từ): chuyển giao. "Transfer risk" = chuyển rủi ro cho bên khác (bảo hiểm, nhà thầu); nghĩa khác "bank transfer".
items.explanationEn: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (verb): to pass to another party. "Transfer risk" means passing it to another party (insurer, contractor); another sense is "bank transfer".

items.question: Trong câu "Buy insurance, contract a third party to take responsibility, use a managed service rather than self-hosting.", từ "contract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buy insurance, contract a third party to take responsibility, use a managed service rather than self-hosting.", what does "contract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contract /kənˈtrækt/ (động từ): thuê theo hợp đồng. Động từ "contract someone to do something" = thuê ai làm gì theo hợp đồng; lưu ý trọng âm danh từ /ˈkɒn.trækt/.
items.explanationEn: contract /kənˈtrækt/ (verb): to hire under an agreement. "Contract someone to do something" means hiring them under an agreement; the noun is stressed /ˈkɒn.trækt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Note: transfer does not make the risk disappear, and you still bear the business consequence if it occurs.", từ "bear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note: transfer does not make the risk disappear, and you still bear the business consequence if it occurs.", what does "bear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bear /beər/ (động từ): gánh chịu. "Bear the consequence/cost" = gánh chịu hậu quả/chi phí; "can't bear it" = không chịu nổi.
items.explanationEn: bear /beər/ (verb): to accept responsibility for. "Bear the consequence or cost" means taking responsibility for it; "can't bear it" means cannot tolerate it.

items.question: Trong câu "record it and prepare a contingency plan with a clear trigger condition.", từ "contingency plan" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "record it and prepare a contingency plan with a clear trigger condition.", what does "contingency plan" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: contingency plan /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si plæn/ (cụm từ): kế hoạch dự phòng. "Contingency plan" = phương án dự phòng khi rủi ro xảy ra; hay đi với "trigger condition".
items.explanationEn: contingency plan /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si plæn/ (phrase): a backup plan for problems. A "contingency plan" is a backup plan used if a risk happens; it often pairs with a "trigger condition".

items.question: Trong câu "Acceptance is a legitimate and often correct decision.", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acceptance is a legitimate and often correct decision.", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (tính từ): chính đáng, hợp lý. "A legitimate decision" = một quyết định chính đáng; nghĩa khác là hợp pháp ("a legitimate business").
items.explanationEn: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (adjective): reasonable and acceptable. "A legitimate decision" is a reasonable one; another sense is lawful, as in "a legitimate business".

items.question: Trong câu "The problem only arises when a risk is accepted without anyone knowing it was accepted — at which point it is not a decision, it is an oversight.", từ "arise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The problem only arises when a risk is accepted without anyone knowing it was accepted — at which point it is not a decision, it is an oversight.", what does "arise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arise /əˈraɪz/ (động từ): nảy sinh, phát sinh. "The problem arises" = vấn đề phát sinh; cụm "if the need arises" = nếu cần.
items.explanationEn: arise /əˈraɪz/ (verb): to come into being. "The problem arises" means it appears; compare "if the need arises".

items.question: Trong câu "The problem only arises when a risk is accepted without anyone knowing it was accepted — at which point it is not a decision, it is an oversight.", từ "oversight" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The problem only arises when a risk is accepted without anyone knowing it was accepted — at which point it is not a decision, it is an oversight.", what does "oversight" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: oversight /ˈəʊ.və.saɪt/ (danh từ): sự sơ suất, bỏ sót. "It is an oversight" = đó là một sơ suất; nghĩa khác "oversight committee" = uỷ ban giám sát.
items.explanationEn: oversight /ˈəʊ.və.saɪt/ (noun): a mistake of not noticing. "It is an oversight" means a failure to notice; another sense is supervision, as in "oversight committee".

items.question: Trong câu "On reserves — two different kinds, and mixing them causes arguments", từ "reserve" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On reserves — two different kinds, and mixing them causes arguments", what does "reserve" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an amount kept for later need
items.explanation: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (danh từ): khoản dự phòng. "Contingency reserve" = khoản dự phòng cho rủi ro đã biết; nghĩa khác "nature reserve" = khu bảo tồn.
items.explanationEn: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (noun): an amount kept for later need. A "contingency reserve" is money or time kept for known risks; another sense is "nature reserve".

items.question: Trong câu "One way to size the reserve: sum the expected impact of register risks, weighted by probability.", từ "size" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One way to size the reserve: sum the expected impact of register risks, weighted by probability.", what does "size" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: size /saɪz/ (động từ): xác định quy mô. "Size the reserve" = ước tính độ lớn của khoản dự phòng; tương tự "size a task" trong Agile.
items.explanationEn: size /saɪz/ (verb): to work out how big. "Size the reserve" means estimating how large it should be; similar to "size a task" in Agile.

items.question: Trong câu "One way to size the reserve: sum the expected impact of register risks, weighted by probability.", từ "weight" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One way to size the reserve: sum the expected impact of register risks, weighted by probability.", what does "weight" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: weight /weɪt/ (động từ): nhân theo trọng số. "Weighted by probability" = tính theo trọng số xác suất; cụm "weighted average" = trung bình có trọng số.
items.explanationEn: weight /weɪt/ (verb): to adjust by importance. "Weighted by probability" means each value is scaled by its likelihood; compare "weighted average".

items.question: Trong câu "A four-week slip at 25 percent probability contributes one week to the reserve.", từ "contribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A four-week slip at 25 percent probability contributes one week to the reserve.", what does "contribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): góp phần, đóng góp. "Contribute X to Y" = đóng góp X vào Y; cũng dùng "contribute to open source".
items.explanationEn: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to add to a total. "Contribute X to Y" means adding X to Y; also "contribute to open source".

items.question: Trong câu "Without indicators, a risk register is a list of worries.", từ "register" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without indicators, a risk register is a list of worries.", what does "register" (noun) mean?
options: sổ đăng ký, bảng theo dõi
optionsEn: a cash machine in a shop
items.explanation: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (danh từ): sổ đăng ký, bảng theo dõi. "Risk register" = bảng theo dõi rủi ro của dự án; nghĩa khác "cash register", "CPU register".
items.explanationEn: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (noun): an official record list. A "risk register" is the record of a project's risks; other senses are "cash register" and "CPU register".

items.question: Trong câu "Without indicators, a risk register is a list of worries.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without indicators, a risk register is a list of worries.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (danh từ): chỉ báo. "Early warning indicator" = chỉ báo cảnh báo sớm; trong xe hơi "indicator" là đèn xi nhan.
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (noun): a measurable warning sign. An "early warning indicator" signals trouble ahead; in a car, the "indicator" is the turn signal.

items.question: Trong câu "Two consecutive sprints under 80 percent of commitment", từ "consecutive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two consecutive sprints under 80 percent of commitment", what does "consecutive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.tɪv/ (tính từ): liên tiếp. "Two consecutive sprints" = hai sprint liên tiếp; đồng nghĩa "in a row".
items.explanationEn: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.tɪv/ (adjective): following one after another. "Two consecutive sprints" means two in a row.

items.question: Trong câu "Two consecutive sprints under 80 percent of commitment", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two consecutive sprints under 80 percent of commitment", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): khối lượng đã cam kết. "80 percent of commitment" = 80% khối lượng đã cam kết trong sprint; nghĩa khác là sự tận tâm.
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): the amount of work promised. "80 percent of commitment" means 80% of the work promised for the sprint; another sense is dedication.

items.question: Trong câu "Regression defects rising across three consecutive releases", từ "regression" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regression defects rising across three consecutive releases", what does "regression" (noun) mean?
options: lỗi tính năng cũ tái phát
items.explanation: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (danh từ): lỗi tính năng cũ tái phát. "Regression defects" = lỗi ở tính năng cũ vốn đang chạy tốt; "regression testing" = kiểm thử hồi quy.
items.explanationEn: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (noun): old features breaking again. "Regression defects" are bugs in features that used to work; "regression testing" checks for them.

items.question: Trong câu "Regression defects rising across three consecutive releases", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regression defects rising across three consecutive releases", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Defect" = lỗi, khuyết tật (đồng nghĩa "bug"); động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ = đào ngũ, bỏ phe.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. A "defect" is a fault, similar to "bug"; the verb "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ means to switch sides.

items.question: Trong câu "Parallel work-in-progress per person climbing steadily", từ "steadily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Parallel work-in-progress per person climbing steadily", what does "steadily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: steadily /ˈsted.əl.i/ (trạng từ): đều đặn, liên tục. "Climbing steadily" = tăng đều đặn; tính từ "steady".
items.explanationEn: steadily /ˈsted.əl.i/ (adverb): at an even rate. "Climbing steadily" means rising at an even rate; the adjective is "steady".

items.question: Trong câu "An indicator — what shows it is approaching.", từ "approach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An indicator — what shows it is approaching.", what does "approach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (động từ): đến gần. "It is approaching" = nó đang đến gần; danh từ "approach" = cách tiếp cận.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (verb): to come nearer. "It is approaching" means it is coming closer; the noun "approach" means a method.

items.question: Trong câu "A trigger condition — the point at which you switch to the contingency plan.", từ "trigger condition" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A trigger condition — the point at which you switch to the contingency plan.", what does "trigger condition" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a condition that sets off action
items.explanation: trigger condition /ˈtrɪɡ.ər kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (cụm từ): điều kiện kích hoạt. "Trigger condition" = điều kiện mà khi đạt tới thì kích hoạt kế hoạch dự phòng.
items.explanationEn: trigger condition /ˈtrɪɡ.ər kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (phrase): a condition that sets off action. A "trigger condition" is the point that sets off the contingency plan.

items.question: Trong câu "On trigger conditions: decide them IN ADVANCE.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On trigger conditions: decide them IN ADVANCE.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): trước, từ trước. "Decide in advance" = quyết định trước; cụm "pay in advance" = trả trước.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Decide in advance" means deciding beforehand; compare "pay in advance".

items.question: Trong câu "If we still have no partner API by March 10, we switch to mock data and split integration into a later release.", từ "mock" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If we still have no partner API by March 10, we switch to mock data and split integration into a later release.", what does "mock" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mock /mɒk/ (tính từ): giả lập, dùng thử. "Mock data" = dữ liệu giả để phát triển/kiểm thử; động từ "mock" còn nghĩa là chế giễu.
items.explanationEn: mock /mɒk/ (adjective): fake, used for testing. "Mock data" is fake data for development or testing; the verb "mock" also means to make fun of.

items.question: Trong câu "A risk register is a LIVING document, and the surest sign of ceremonial risk management is a register unchanged for three months.", từ "ceremonial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A risk register is a LIVING document, and the surest sign of ceremonial risk management is a register unchanged for three months.", what does "ceremonial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ceremonial /ˌser.ɪˈməʊ.ni.əl/ (tính từ): hình thức, chiếu lệ. "Ceremonial risk management" = quản lý rủi ro cho có, chỉ mang tính hình thức.
items.explanationEn: ceremonial /ˌser.ɪˈməʊ.ni.əl/ (adjective): done only for show. "Ceremonial risk management" is done only for appearance, not to change anything.

items.question: Trong câu "A risk register is a LIVING document, and the surest sign of ceremonial risk management is a register unchanged for three months.", từ "living document" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A risk register is a LIVING document, and the surest sign of ceremonial risk management is a register unchanged for three months.", what does "living document" (phrase) mean?
options: tài liệu cập nhật liên tục
items.explanation: living document /ˈlɪv.ɪŋ ˈdɒk.jə.mənt/ (cụm từ): tài liệu cập nhật liên tục. "Living document" = tài liệu luôn được cập nhật theo thực tế, không đóng băng.
items.explanationEn: living document /ˈlɪv.ɪŋ ˈdɒk.jə.mənt/ (phrase): a document updated continually. A "living document" is kept up to date continually rather than frozen.

items.question: Trong câu "A pragmatic cadence", từ "cadence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pragmatic cadence", what does "cadence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rise and fall of a voice
items.explanation: cadence /ˈkeɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): nhịp độ định kỳ. "Meeting cadence" = nhịp họp định kỳ (hằng tuần, mỗi sprint); nghĩa gốc là ngữ điệu, nhịp.
items.explanationEn: cadence /ˈkeɪ.dəns/ (noun): a regular rhythm of activity. "Meeting cadence" is how regularly meetings happen; the original sense is the rhythm of a voice.

items.question: Trong câu "A pragmatic cadence", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pragmatic cadence", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (tính từ): thực tế, thiết thực. "Pragmatic" = thực dụng, hướng tới cái làm được; cụm "a pragmatic approach".
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (adjective): practical and realistic. "Pragmatic" means focused on what works in practice; e.g. "a pragmatic approach".

items.question: Trong câu "Weekly, fifteen minutes: which indicators have moved? Which risks are spent? Any new ones?", từ "spent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weekly, fifteen minutes: which indicators have moved? Which risks are spent? Any new ones?", what does "spent" (adjective) mean?
options: đã hết hiệu lực, không còn
items.explanation: spent /spent/ (tính từ): đã hết hiệu lực, không còn. "Spent risks" = rủi ro đã qua, không còn khả năng xảy ra; "feel spent" = kiệt sức.
items.explanationEn: spent /spent/ (adjective): used up, no longer active. "Spent risks" are ones that can no longer happen; "feel spent" means exhausted.

items.question: Trong câu "At each major milestone: review everything, since the context has shifted enough.", từ "milestone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At each major milestone: review everything, since the context has shifted enough.", what does "milestone" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stəʊn/ (danh từ): cột mốc quan trọng. "Major milestone" = cột mốc lớn của dự án; "hit a milestone" = đạt cột mốc.
items.explanationEn: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stəʊn/ (noun): an important point in progress. A "major milestone" is a key point in a project; you "hit a milestone".

items.question: Trong câu "On any scope change: every change opens new risk, and that belongs in the impact analysis.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On any scope change: every change opens new risk, and that belongs in the impact analysis.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi công việc. "Scope change" = thay đổi phạm vi; cụm "scope creep" = phạm vi phình dần.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the extent of work covered. A "scope change" alters what the project covers; "scope creep" is uncontrolled growth of scope.

items.question: Trong câu "On any scope change: every change opens new risk, and that belongs in the impact analysis.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On any scope change: every change opens new risk, and that belongs in the impact analysis.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
options: nên nằm ở, thuộc về chỗ
optionsEn: to have its proper place in
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): nên nằm ở, thuộc về chỗ. "Belong in X" = đúng chỗ của nó là trong X; "belong to" = thuộc sở hữu của.
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to have its proper place in. "Belong in X" means its right place is in X; "belong to" means owned by.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the raw material for the next project's checklist.", từ "raw material" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the raw material for the next project's checklist.", what does "raw material" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: raw material /rɔː məˈtɪə.ri.əl/ (cụm từ): nguyên liệu đầu vào. Nghĩa bóng "raw material for something" = chất liệu, dữ liệu đầu vào để tạo ra thứ khác.
items.explanationEn: raw material /rɔː məˈtɪə.ri.əl/ (phrase): basic input for making something. Figuratively, "raw material for something" is the basic input used to build it.

items.question: Trong câu "The precondition for everything above: the team must feel safe raising risks.", từ "precondition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The precondition for everything above: the team must feel safe raising risks.", what does "precondition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precondition /ˌpriː.kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): điều kiện tiên quyết. "Precondition for something" = điều kiện phải có trước; đồng nghĩa "prerequisite".
items.explanationEn: precondition /ˌpriː.kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (noun): a thing required first. A "precondition for something" must be true first; synonym "prerequisite".

items.question: Trong câu "The precondition for everything above: the team must feel safe raising risks.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The precondition for everything above: the team must feel safe raising risks.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra, đề cập. "Raise a risk/issue/concern" = nêu ra rủi ro/vấn đề/mối lo; cụm rất hay dùng nơi công sở.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up for discussion. "Raise a risk, issue or concern" means bringing it up; a very common workplace phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "or handed extra work as a punishment — risks will only be raised once they are already issues.", từ "punishment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "or handed extra work as a punishment — risks will only be raised once they are already issues.", what does "punishment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: punishment /ˈpʌn.ɪʃ.mənt/ (danh từ): sự trừng phạt. "As a punishment" = như một hình phạt; động từ "punish".
items.explanationEn: punishment /ˈpʌn.ɪʃ.mənt/ (noun): a penalty for doing wrong. "As a punishment" means as a penalty; the verb is "punish".

items.question: Trong câu "when the person lacks the authority to solve it", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when the person lacks the authority to solve it", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thẩm quyền. "Lack the authority to do something" = không có thẩm quyền làm gì; "the authorities" = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the power to decide. "Lack the authority to do something" means not having the power to do it; "the authorities" are official bodies.

items.question: Trong câu "once the risk materialises.", từ "materialise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "once the risk materialises.", what does "materialise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: materialise /məˈtɪə.ri.ə.laɪz/ (động từ): trở thành hiện thực. "The risk materialises" = rủi ro thành sự thật; chính tả Mỹ "materialize".
items.explanationEn: materialise /məˈtɪə.ri.ə.laɪz/ (verb): to actually happen. "The risk materialises" means it actually happens; US spelling "materialize".

items.question: Trong câu "A well-written risk gives you a preventive action, an indicator, and a number to weigh against cost.", từ "weigh" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A well-written risk gives you a preventive action, an indicator, and a number to weigh against cost.", what does "weigh" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: weigh /weɪ/ (động từ): cân nhắc so sánh. "Weigh A against B" = cân nhắc A so với B; "weigh the pros and cons".
items.explanationEn: weigh /weɪ/ (verb): to compare carefully. "Weigh A against B" means comparing them carefully; e.g. "weigh the pros and cons".

items.question: Trong câu "A register unchanged for three months signals ceremonial risk management.", từ "signal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A register unchanged for three months signals ceremonial risk management.", what does "signal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (động từ): là dấu hiệu cho thấy. "X signals Y" = X là dấu hiệu cho thấy Y; danh từ "a warning signal" = tín hiệu cảnh báo.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (verb): to be a sign of. "X signals Y" means X is a sign of Y; the noun appears in "a warning signal".

items.question: Trong câu "Record the risks that did not occur, or preventive spending gets cut as needless worry.", từ "needless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the risks that did not occur, or preventive spending gets cut as needless worry.", what does "needless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: needless /ˈniːd.ləs/ (tính từ): không cần thiết. "Needless worry" = nỗi lo không cần thiết; cụm "needless to say" = khỏi phải nói.
items.explanationEn: needless /ˈniːd.ləs/ (adjective): not necessary. "Needless worry" is unnecessary concern; "needless to say" means obviously.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk management starts with writing the risk properly, since the wording decides whether anything can be done about it.", từ "wording" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk management starts with writing the risk properly, since the wording decides whether anything can be done about it.", what does "wording" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: wording /ˈwɜː.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách diễn đạt. "The wording" = cách dùng từ, cách diễn đạt; "careful wording" = diễn đạt cẩn thận.
items.explanationEn: wording /ˈwɜː.dɪŋ/ (noun): the choice of words. "The wording" is how something is phrased; e.g. "careful wording".

items.question: Trong câu "All four response strategies are valid, acceptance included, provided the decision is recorded.", từ "provided" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All four response strategies are valid, acceptance included, provided the decision is recorded.", what does "provided" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (liên từ): miễn là, với điều kiện. "Provided (that)" = với điều kiện là; đồng nghĩa "as long as".
items.explanationEn: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (conjunction): on condition that. "Provided (that)" means on condition that; synonym "as long as".
